set.body: Every plan page published to the wiki carries the banner 'Current — the latest status report. Reports freeze once published…'. Two things are wrong. The noun falls back to 'status' because plans carry no kind field, so a plan is described as a status report. And the banner is derived from truth_state alone and never consults the item's status, so a completed plan is indistinguishable from one still in flight. This is why the plan pages had to be corrected at the source instead of at the render layer. The rendering code is vendored from the worklog tooling, so the fix belongs upstream rather than as a local patch that the next upgrade would overwrite.
set.title: Plan pages get a status-report banner that ignores their status

set.resolution: Bundle membership is now decided by the walk-up test; the cheap pre-check only rejects non-Markdown. Repo-level .okf and sample-okf fallbacks removed so unrelated files are never curated against a bundle they are not in. PR #26
Checkboxes on the two completed plan pages now agree with the tracker and the repo link points at the current org; the historical prose describing what a task did was left frozen. PR #25
Unverified concepts escalate one tier via an explicit map; medium now reaches high instead of assigning to itself. PR #29
Concept lookup resolves in tiers and reports candidates when a tier is ambiguous instead of returning whichever matched first. PR #29

Behaviour was correct and the guard was misleading: markdown edges are always links_to, so frontmatter is always at least as specific. Tautological condition removed, docstring now explains the precedence. PR #29
Undirected adjacency built in one pass; output verified byte-identical at 1 through 4 hops. PR #29
Targets resolving outside the bundle are collected and reported by validate as warnings, so a mistyped path is visible; default exit stays 0 and --strict gates it. PR #29
Bundle load skips dot-directories as well as dotfiles, matched on bundle-relative parts so a bundle living under a dot-directory still loads. PR #29
Work log pushed to the current tracker as issues 14-23 and 27, after unlinking six external keys that still pointed at the pre-move repository

set.body: Validation skips the bundle root index.md and log.md entirely, so a broken link or a link pointing outside the bundle in either file is never reported. Confirmed with a fixture: an off-bundle link in a concept is flagged, the identical link in index.md is silent. The root index is the bundle's entry point and the most linked-from file it has, which makes it the worst place to lose link checking. The exemption predates this release; it was surfaced while adding out-of-bundle reporting.
set.title: Root index.md and log.md are exempt from all link validation
